description: Angular component for the application header, providing navigation links, user authentication controls, and responsive behavior.

classes.name: HeaderComponent
classes.description: Angular component that renders the top navigation bar with routing links, sign-in/sign-out controls, and mobile menu toggle.

methods.name: toggleMobileNav
methods.description: Toggles the visibility state of the mobile navigation menu.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks whether the user is authenticated.

methods.name: displayName
methods.description: Computed property that returns the display name for the current user, falling back to email or a default string.

methods.name: loading
methods.description: Computed property that reflects the current loading state from the auth store.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Initiates sign-in process using Google OAuth.

methods.name: onResize
methods.description: Handles window resize events to close the mobile navigation if the viewport is expanded.

ctags.name: canCheck
ctags.pattern: /^    const canCheck = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && typeof (globalThis as any).matchMedia /
